items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I was talking to Gerry Mulligan’s first wife, Arlene, whose father was Lou Brown of DeSilva, Brown and Henderson.

ctx.x: Yes. We’ve been thinking about that same subject ourselves.

It’s a brute. But the worst in the music clearance. And there are 23 musical numbers in this movie. And there’s something called a “most favored nations.” And that means whichever publisher gets the most money gets matched by all the others. So we were going along trying to cut corners. Now we had to clear for overseas cable, regular television, theaters, festivals, all kinds of stuff. And so we shaved a few years off and did this and did that to make everything kind of come together, until the last tune. And…
